title: Dynamic Feedback Control of a DC Motor Using Bode and Nyquist Analysis
expert_review: A classic control problem illustrating integral control design for DC motor speed regulation using frequency-domain methods.
learning_objectives: Model DC motor dynamics using transfer functions
Design integral controllers for reference tracking
Apply Bode plots to compute stability margins
Use Nyquist criterion to verify closed-loop stability
Interpret robustness measures in practical control systems
